title: Yellowed Flaky Turkish Pastry Pide
description: A traditional Turkish pastry featuring vanilla bean paste and a sweet glaze, perfect for a midnight craving. This egg-free friendly dish is a must try for anyone looking for a unique dessert experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add melted butter, whole milk, and vanilla bean paste to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a pide form.
Place the pide on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pide from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the glaze over the pide and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
